PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.section1_content: This privacy policy informs you about the nature, scope, and purpose of the processing of personal data on our website.
PrivacyPage.section3_hosting_content: This website is self-hosted on a dedicated server by {hostingProvider}, {hostingAddress}. The server may automatically record standard access log data (IP address, browser type, timestamp, requested URL) as part of normal server operation. This data is used solely for security and availability purposes and is not shared with third parties. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
PrivacyPage.section3_tracking_content: This website uses {analyticsTool}, an open-source, self-hosted analytics tool ({analyticsDomain}). {analyticsTool} does not use cookies and does not collect any personally identifiable information. Only anonymised data such as page views, referrers, and device type are recorded. The data is stored exclusively on my own server and is not shared with third parties. The legal basis is my legitimate interest in understanding aggregate website usage (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
PrivacyPage.section3_contact_content: When you use our contact form, the information provided is processed internally for the purpose of handling your request. This data is not passed to third parties. The processing is based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
PrivacyPage.section4_title: 3. Your Rights as a Data Subject
PrivacyPage.section4_content: Within the framework of the applicable legal provisions, you have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of the data processing, and, if applicable, a right to correction or deletion of this data.

BannerPage.title: LinkedIn Banner Generator
BannerPage.subtitle: Create an ATS-friendly, brand-aligned LinkedIn background banner matching your portfolio theme. Features live safe-area overlays and export options.
BannerPage.researchTitle: LinkedIn Banner Specifications & Safe Area Research
BannerPage.researchIntro: Official background dimensions and safe area recommendations based on 2025/2026 LinkedIn viewport tests.
BannerPage.specDimensionsDesc: 1584 × 396 pixels (exact 4:1 aspect ratio). Supported formats: PNG and JPG under 8 MB. PNG is recommended for razor-sharp typography and code badges.
BannerPage.specDesktopSafeDesc: On desktop, LinkedIn renders a 160px circular profile photo over the bottom-left corner. All templates reserve the left 340px to ensure zero text or badge collision.
BannerPage.specMobileSafeDesc: Mobile apps crop up to 15% from left and right edges. Keep critical messaging centered within the central 1260 × 316 px safe zone.
